head: 7c326fb7ea5ef3ea45eeb0596e1bd52fbb9e4d77
title: Experiment 20: G0 PASS and frozen CPU calibration; trainer FAILED
body:
## Summary

Completes the dispatcher-authorized post-stop CPU Phase 0 on all 4,312 saved generations. G0 **PASS**: area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) **0.9313 [0.9093, 0.9519], p=0.0001** versus 0.70; active-group log loss **0.3044** versus **0.4812** for the population baseline. Intervals use 10,000 paired bootstraps over 400 train groups / 539 tasks, conditional on fitted predictions and selection. Native item-parameter freezing verified for all 539 tasks. The trainer remains **FAILED**; no pilot or further GPU jobs ran.

Expected calibration error is **0.1122 [0.0978, 0.1375]**, with predicted active share 24.85% versus observed 13.73%. Features-only AUC is **0.9243 [0.9018, 0.9470]** and scalar panel pass-rate AUC **0.8632 [0.8226, 0.9010]**. These calibration results do not establish a downstream training benefit. Strict scores cover 4,312/4,312 cells; smooth reward is known for 4,202, with 110 duplicate-declaration cells retained as missing. Registered graded and tied/untied analyses are complete.

Saved smoke update 2 has 22,459 finite mismatches plus 195 unsupported actions among 864,717 tokens (2.61982%). The experiment 13 v4 T1 analogue fails zero unsupported actions; the median meets its threshold by a bound, while the 99th-percentile criterion is unresolved from saved receipts. Original trainer gate unchanged. All scientific outputs and native freeze completed before a terminal logging TypeError; the original failed receipt is retained alongside verified metadata-only recovery.

## Test plan

- Full `make test`: **1,415 passed, 17 skipped, 6 subtests**; all 46 tested runtime/scientific source hashes unchanged.
- D-109 audit: **11,859 compiler calls, 224 source output files, 64/64 completion receipts**, zero errors. Independent bootstrap replay and final artifact verification **PASS**; all 571 fit artifacts retained, native forecast hash verified.
- Terminal-metadata recovery fixtures: idempotence and wrong-error rejection **PASS**; original failed run receipt, source, input pins, numerical outputs and forecast unchanged. Exact staged diff, data formats and secret checks passed.

Resources: 198.2292 Sherlock allocated CPU-hours, separately 2.2394 local actual process CPU-hours; historical 7.8258 GPU-hours; $0 API spend. All owned jobs terminal, temporary verification checkout removed. PR remains unmerged; future trainer work requires a separate instruction.
